subject: Vendor kickoff — legal checklist, demo window, and MSA walkthrough
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@cleardata.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cleardata.com, Legal Ops <legalops@cleardata.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff + MSA redline walkthrough and short demo

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick responses last week. ClearData is ready to move into onboarding — we have procurement and legal lined up and would like to:

- Run a short 20-minute product demo for stakeholders (product + ops)
- Do a 45–60 minute MSA redline walkthrough with your legal/ops folks to confirm outstanding terms and next steps
- Make sure we capture the vendor onboarding checklist items (security questionnaire + audit evidence requests)

Attached is our preferred MSA redline (MSA_DRAFT_v3.pdf) and a filled onboarding checklist to help you prep. For timing, our procurement and legal folks are available the week of Sep 1–4; proposed windows (PST):

- Tue Sep 2: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed Sep 3: 14:00–17:00 (best for legal)

Can you propose a single combined cadence (demo + redline on same call or split)? Preferably we’d do demo first (20m) then redline.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Khan
Head of Procurement, ClearData
samir@cleardata.com
[Attachment: MSA_DRAFT_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Samir Khan <samir@cleardata.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + MSA redline walkthrough and short demo

Hi Samir — great to hear, and thanks for sending the draft.

We can do the flow you suggested: 20m product demo followed by a 45m redline walkthrough (90m total to give some buffer). Two windows that work for our legal/product team are below (all PT):

- Tue Sep 2, 10:00–11:30 (preferred)
- Wed Sep 3, 14:00–15:30 (alternative)

If your legal prefers later on Wed we can flex to 15:00 start.

Attendees from Redwood: me (vendor success), Marissa Cole (solutions), Karthik Iyer (legal liaison / contracts), Monica Patel (onboarding lead).

Quick clarification before we lock the invite: does ClearData want a line-by-line redline walkthrough (we’ll have Karthik share the contract tracker) or a higher-level discussion of key terms to unblock procurement? Either works — just different prep.

I’ll tentatively hold both windows on our side. If you confirm one slot I’ll send an invite and a short agenda + pre-call checklist link.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

- 15:00–15:20: Product demo (Marissa, product highlights + Q/A)
- 15:20–16:35: MSA redline walkthrough (Karthik + Redwood legal)
- 16:35–16:45: Action items & next steps (Vanessa / Monica)

Pre-call ask: Samir / legalops — please upload the top 6 MSA comments to the Drive link below before 12:00 PT Wed so Karthik can prioritize responses. Monica will prepare the onboarding evidence checklist.

Drive pre-call link: https://drive.redwood.com/clear-data/onboarding/msadocs
DocuSign prep link: https://app.docusign.com/cleardata/msadraft

Action items assigned:
